## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
RISK-OFF, Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive (Mixed/Rotation). Confirmations: VXX rising and SPY/TLT and HYG/LQD falling, with XLK in BELOW TREND (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -16.71%).

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Fear increasing: VXX (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +27.32%) ABOVE TREND; credit stress rising as HYG/LQD falls (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -2.03%) BELOW TREND. Stocks lagging bonds: SPY/TLT (1W: -2.46% | 1M: -10.10%) BELOW TREND.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Dollar strength is firming (1W: +0.59% | 1M: +0.38%), ABOVE TREND; the yield-curve indicator is rising (1W: +0.02% | 1M: +4.50%), ABOVE TREND. Duration preference is mixed: (1W: -0.16% | 1M: +2.24%), CORRECTION.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Financials and Discretionary are holding up: XLF (1W: +1.15% | 1M: +5.40%) and XLY (1W: +1.91% | 1M: +5.25%) are ABOVE TREND; XLK (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -16.71%) is BELOW TREND. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive; Style: Value over Growth, with the tech-financial ratio falling (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -20.65%) BELOW TREND.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US weakness contrasts with selective regional strength: SPY (1W: -2.70% | 1M: -4.99%) BELOW TREND, while FXI (1W: +5.65% | 1M: +4.48%) and INDA (1W: +6.64% | 1M: +11.70%) are ABOVE TREND. EEM (1W: -2.80% | 1M: -10.24%) is BELOW TREND; VGK (1W: -0.26% | 1M: +2.20%) is in CORRECTION.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Speculation is weak: ARKK (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -13.86%) and IBIT (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -7.31%) are BELOW TREND. IWM (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -1.41%) is also BELOW TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Copper shows cyclical weakness: CPER (1W: -3.39% | 1M: -4.54%) BELOW TREND, with the copper/gold ratio falling (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -3.52%) BELOW TREND. Gold is recovering: GLD (1W: +4.71% | 1M: -1.61%) RECOVERY.

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy is weak: XLE (1W: -12.00% | 1M: -5.55%) and BNO (1W: -12.84% | 1M: -2.23%) are BELOW TREND. UNG (1W: +2.97% | 1M: -13.51%) is in RECOVERY.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
CONFIRMED: XLK (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -16.71%) and SPY (1W: -2.70% | 1M: -4.99%) are BELOW TREND; XLF (1W: +1.15% | 1M: +5.40%) is ABOVE TREND. Divergence: several sectors have positive monthly returns but weaker weekly action, including XLU (1W: -0.69% | 1M: +5.02%) in CORRECTION.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor relative resilience in XLF (1W: +1.15% | 1M: +5.40%) and XLY (1W: +1.91% | 1M: +5.25%), both ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to XLK (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -16.71%), BELOW TREND. Keep risk measured as VXX (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +27.32%) remains ABOVE TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: If breadth improves and leadership holds, monitor XLF (1W: +1.15% | 1M: +5.40%) and XLY (1W: +1.91% | 1M: +5.25%), both ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: If weakness broadens, watch XLK (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -16.71%), BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: If the rebound persists, monitor GLD (1W: +4.71% | 1M: -1.61%), in RECOVERY.  
BEARISH: If cyclical momentum stays soft, watch CPER (1W: -3.39% | 1M: -4.54%) and XLE (1W: -12.00% | 1M: -5.55%), both BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**  
Monitor VXX at 21.9500 (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +27.32%), ABOVE TREND; HYG/LQD at 0.7388 (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -2.03%), BELOW TREND. Also watch XLK/XLF at 2.8821 (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -20.65%), BELOW TREND, and copper/gold at 0.1011 (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -3.52%), BELOW TREND.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, indicating mixed breadth. Financials and Discretionary show relative strength, favoring Value over Growth. Monitor rising fear, weakening credit ratios, and the sharp technology drawdown.
